normalization_plan.reason: The _to argument only exists to be forwarded to transferFrom; it carries no independent semantics
The _value argument is a pure passthrough into transferFrom
_from is the indexing key for balanceOf/allowance inside transferFrom
_to is the credit key for balanceOf inside transferFrom
_value drives the unchecked balance arithmetic of transferFrom
_from is consumed only by the whitelist comparisons of ensure
_to is consumed only by the owner comparison of ensure
_value is forwarded to condition from ensure
_from is only used to read _onSaleNum in condition
_value is only used for the min/max sale bounds in condition
Parameter a is the delegatecall target and has no meaning outside that operation

saleNum is assigned directly to _saleNum inside init
token feeds the overflow-prone multiplication that produces _minSale
maxToken feeds the overflow-prone multiplication that produces _maxSale
_tos is the iteration source of the batchSend loop

addr is stored verbatim into tradeAddress
